name: pm-copilot-probe
description: Test extension. Reports how its own Python runtime was resolved, to find out whether a .mcpb can ship a Python MCP server with no prerequisites on the machine.
long_description: Does nothing useful. It exists to answer one question: can an extension carry its own uv binary and bootstrap a Python MCP server without the machine having Python or uv already? Install it, run its one tool, then uninstall it.

tools.name: pm_copilot_probe
tools.description: Report which Python and uv this extension actually used, and whether either came from the machine or from inside the bundle
